style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Adopt MOE primary sense: entering every available gap. Modern cozy home on windy winter day. Pale blue pencil-line draughts and a few tiny dry leaves clearly enter through three different small gaps: under closed door, crack beside window frame, and small wall vent. All wind streams flow inward and stir the curtain, a loose paper on table and scarf fringe. Parent presses weatherstripping onto window gap while child curls under blanket on sofa noticing drafts from other sides. Clear many tiny openings let cold air penetrate everywhere despite mostly shut room. No magical solid wind objects, use subtle translucent motion lines as illustrative convention. Coherent door window architecture, realistic curtain gravity, no floating furniture, natural hands and two arms. 3:2 landscape graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no text brands logos letters numbers watermarks.
adopted_sense: 任何空隙沒有不鑽進去的
alt: 冷風從關著的門下、窗框裂縫與牆上小通氣孔鑽入，吹動窗簾和紙張，家長忙著封窗，孩子裹著毯子。
